gloss: station passed without stopping; non-stop station

definitions.gloss: station passed without stopping; non-stop station
definitions.explanation: a train station that a particular service (typically express or limited express) passes through without making a stop

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通過駅|つうかえき}だ。
examples.english: This station is one that the express passes through.

examples.japanese: {通過駅|つうかえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}らないで→立ち入る：26367_tachiiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not enter the platform at stations where the train passes through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通過駅|つうかえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{各停|かくてい}→各停：09214_kakutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}え→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I live at a station the limited express passes through, so I have to transfer to a local train every morning.

notes:
Combines ⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧ (passing through) and ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (station). A practical term for anyone using Japanese rail, where different service levels (local, rapid, express, limited express) stop at different stations. A {通過駅|つうかえき} for one service may be a regular stop for a slower service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通過駅|つうかえき}: express non-stop station
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧{通過駅|つうかえき}: limited express non-stop station
- {通過駅|つうかえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check which stations are skipped

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {停車駅|ていしゃえき}: stopping station — the opposite; a station where the train does stop
- ⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧: passing through — the general term for passing through without stopping
- ⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧: local train — a service that stops at every station
